items.office: Member, San Francisco Board of Supervisors (District 6)
items.jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco

citations.quote: As a San Francisco Supervisor from 2011 to 2019, Jane represented a district encompassing both the city’s lowest-income residents and its wealthiest zip code.

items.office: President, San Francisco Board of Education

citations.quote: If Jane Kim looks familiar, it could be that you recognize her as the SF Board of Education president, not to mention the leading candidate in the race for District 6 supervisor (a post held by controversial legislator Chris Daly since 2000).
